booking.howItWorks: Parties and group events are booked by sending an inquiry with your preferred dates and times, or by calling (253) 474-0594.

packages.name: Birthday Parties
packages.description: Bowling parties for birthdays and other celebrations for all ages. Inquire about times, dates and party options.

packages.name: Corporate and Group Events
packages.description: A fun evening out with colleagues or a group of friends. Send an inquiry to request your best dates and times.

faq.a: We provide bowling leagues for all ages. Please inquire about our pricing, seasons and special offers for league bowling.

faq.q: Do you have food and drinks?
faq.a: We have 36 lanes along with our Beach Shack Cafe and 2 lounges to serve your needs.

faq.q: What kinds of events can I hold?
faq.a: Birthdays (children AND adults), anniversaries, team building outings, fund raising efforts etc.
